# Air Quality Advisor v0.2.1 — More natural direct announcements with AI

This release adds optional, carefully constrained text rewriting for the existing Home Assistant window-ventilation recommendations.

### What's new

- **Rewrite direct announcements with AI** — new checkbox in **Configure → Announcements** (off by default).
- **Conversation agent dropdown** — Home Assistant's default agent is preselected; choose any available `conversation.*` agent.
- AI creates a more conversational, varied localized sentence before it is sent to direct notification entities and/or TTS speakers, using the same rewrite for both.
- Announcement Hub remains unchanged and **bypasses AI** when selected.
- A bounded text-only prompt, eight-second timeout (three seconds for urgent closing advice) and checks for original window names, area, action and measured values protect delivery. Errors or unexpected text fall back to the exact original message.
- Labels and help available in the existing 38-language catalog. No new sensors, automations or window controls.

### Notes and privacy

AI **never decides when or which window to open or close** and cannot change thresholds. Automatic notify/TTS still need to be enabled independently; the AI checkbox alone does not produce new alerts.

Home Assistant `conversation.process` is a general conversation agent action. An agent with access to device control may still perform actions despite the instruction not to. Use an agent without device-control capabilities where possible. Cloud providers may receive room names, window names and air-quality readings. The built-in default Assist agent is not always a generative model and may simply return the unmodified announcement.

### Install or update

HACS → Air Quality Advisor → **Update to v0.2.1**, restart Home Assistant, then open **Configure → Announcements**. Existing configuration and dashboard data stay intact.

See the [README](https://github.com/Chreece/HA-Air-Quality-Advisor) and [full changelog](https://github.com/Chreece/HA-Air-Quality-Advisor/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
